reason: The premise is wrong. render-b.js MEDIUM maps day:"phone", so state=day renders in a 344px phone card at 390/768/1280/1440 — there is no desk day. The 148px raise is gated on [data-medium="sheet"|"full"]; in the phone medium .b-num measures 96px at all four widths, so "Today" at 96px already sits at its own count's display step. The fix also breaks: "Today" at 148px measures 385px in a 344px content box, overflowing 41px everywhere.
sharpenedFix: No change. If a desk-register day is ever built (MEDIUM.day moved off "phone"), raise .b-dayCount to 148px in the same [data-medium="sheet"|"full"] block that raises .b-num, not before — at phone width it overflows by 41px. Residue worth one line, not a finding: b.css:1034 already raises .b-dayWrap padding for sheet/full, a rule no state can reach today; delete it or let it stand as the hook for that future desk day.
